name: Hell's Gate: Fischer's Tower and the gorge
why: On foot among zebra and giraffe past the volcanic plug of Fischer's Tower to the Ol Njorowa gorge, where hot springs steam out of the walls.
book: Kenya Wildlife Service fees at Elsa Gate; bikes for hire. A local guide is compulsory in the gorge.
dangers: Flash floods in the gorge when it rains on the hills: never enter in rain.

points.name: Elsa Gate
points.note: The main gate of the park near Lake Naivasha.

points.name: Fischer's Tower
points.note: A 25 m volcanic plug where rock climbers practise.

points.name: Ol Njorowa Gorge
points.note: A narrow red gorge with hot springs, the lower gorge of Hell's Gate.
